label: Week 5
method: Saturday rollup of nightly search_news + counts; items already filter-passed; no invented nights
volume_note: Week volume is the sum of nightly volumes. The 2026-10-10 night switched to full 24h total_tweet_count, so that night is not directly comparable to earlier nights.
headline: Week 5’s loudest room was Dallas: Lamb’s 17-catch comeback in Houston gave way to the 24-16 TNF loss to winless Tampa, Dak’s confrontation with a stadium worker, and coaching heat. Chicago lived on Bears–Packers week with Bagent starting again for Caleb Williams and Ben Johnson’s rivalry fire, while Philadelphia traded Cam Jurgens to Baltimore and ruled out Barkley, Smith and Brown for London. New Orleans (45-24 MNF loss to Atlanta, Staley vs. Aikman), Carolina (SNF upset of Detroit, Bryce Young MVP talk), New England–Buffalo fallout, Kansas City’s Tyreek Hill chase, Baltimore’s Lamar ankle and San Francisco’s 4-0 trip to Seattle filled the next tier, and Arizona closed the week finalizing a Marvin Harrison Jr. trade. All seven nights logged; quiet clubs stayed quiet. Vibe only.
